name: builtin-py-package-repair
description: Install the repaired package in a fresh venv and execute its import or console script. Requires Python 3.11+, venv/pip, and package-index access.

cases.prompt: Fix setup.py so installing ur-eval-mypkg automatically installs its missing requests dependency; keep the src-layout package and public API. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.src/mypkg/__init__.py:
import requests
def dependency_name(): return requests.__name__

testFiles.check.py:
import pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, venv
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ur-package-') as tmp:
    venv.create(tmp, with_pip=True)
    python = str(pathlib.Path(tmp) / ('Scripts/python.exe' if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'bin/python'))
    subprocess.run([python,'-m','pip','install','--disable-pip-version-check','setuptools==75.8.0','wheel==0.45.1'],check=True,timeout=120)
    subprocess.run([python,'-m','pip','install','--disable-pip-version-check','--no-build-isolation','.'],check=True,timeout=120)
    subprocess.run([python,'-c',"import mypkg; from importlib.metadata import requires; assert mypkg.dependency_name() == 'requests'; assert any(r.lower().startswith('requests') for r in requires('ur-eval-mypkg'))"],check=True)

cases.prompt: Add a standards-compliant pyproject.toml with setuptools build-system and project name ur-eval-mypkg and version 0.1.0. Preserve the src-layout install and answer() returning 42. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

cases.prompt: Expose the existing mypkg.cli:main as the installed mypkg console command via setup.py or pyproject.toml. Preserve the CLI response hello. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

import pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, venv
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ur-package-') as tmp:
    venv.create(tmp, with_pip=True)
    python = str(pathlib.Path(tmp) / ('Scripts/python.exe' if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'bin/python'))
    subprocess.run([python,'-m','pip','install','--disable-pip-version-check','setuptools==75.8.0','wheel==0.45.1'],check=True,timeout=120)
